# QTL–GWAS coloc mini testdata

Synthetic overlapping locus (10 SNPs) for stub / smoke `coloc.abf`.

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `qtl.tsv` | QTL-side `snp`, `beta`, `se`, `maf`, `n` |
| `gwas.tsv` | GWAS-side same SNPs with correlated effects |

Not a real association study — for pipeline wiring only.
